metadata.title: Adding or Updating Plugins
metadata.description: Complete guide for contributors and agents on how to add new plugins or update existing plugins in the Capgo documentation.

blocks.text: This guide explains how to add new Capacitor plugins to the Capgo website or update existing plugin documentation. This is useful for contributors, maintainers, and AI agents helping to maintain the documentation.
When adding a new plugin to the Capgo ecosystem, you need to update several files and locations across the website to ensure the plugin appears correctly in all relevant places:
- Add plugin metadata to the master list
- Add plugin to the categorized plugin listing page
- Add plugin to the documentation sidebar

: Explain what the plugin does, not what it is
"Control device flashlight and torch with simple on/off toggle"
"Integrate Crisp live chat and customer support into your app"
"Enable secure authentication using Face ID and Touch ID"
: Always begin with clear installation steps
Use TypeScript for all code examples
Demonstrate both basic and advanced usage
Use this checklist when adding a new plugin:
Write and review plugin docs in English. Localized paths are generated by the site metadata and translated at the edge by the translation Worker.
After adding or updating plugin documentation:
: Use the same plugin name everywhere
: Document both iOS and Android setup
: Use relative links and verify they work
: Include all necessary imports in examples
: Be specific about what the plugin does
